source_split: User-supplied approved local revision2 manifest; no membership shipped

model.initialization: full Encoder+Decoder seed42 scratch; Train-only new fixed RQ books/readout
model.activation_checkpoint: patch stem and inner spatial/temporal/FFN only, RNG preserving; no redundant outer checkpoint

precision: FP32 parameters/optimizer/forward/loss; TF32 off; deterministic algorithms; no AMP
label: Old ex45 frozen LABEL_POLICY: membrane N -> shared per-finger LUT exactly once with last-segment linear tail; gen3 native Newton Fz identity; verified source domains, no cache writes, transform native Force before interpolation, no output clipping
sampling: stage uniform -> subject uniform -> hand uniform -> eligible integer gap-contained starts duration proportional; 16-window local trial blocks; all qualified members retained

augmentation: Gaussian noise std .02 including zeroed channel

loss.Corr_and_MAPE_weight: five fingers by mean abs raw force per logical micro; Corr normalized predictions/targets
loss.ordinal: same window/finger 2048 replacement different-time pairs; remove exact GT ties; softplus(-sign(dy)*dp/T_f)/ln2; valid-pair global micro average
loss.temperature: per-finger median nonzero Train-panel absolute differences; frozen both stages
loss.auxiliary_definition: median Train-panel weighted-aux/main all-trainable-param L2 norm ratio before clipping; calibrated once per phase; never equate coefficient or loss ratio to gradient share

phase1.selection: max complete regular-stage Val per-person mean same-window per-finger exact tau-b; reject prediction-constant attrition

cumulative best snapshot every complete epoch
